title: Supply Period Schedule for Blood Glucose Test-Strip Refills
content:
The supply days of a test-strip refill on the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program are set as follows.

**Schedule.** The supply days are, for the first strip refill after a newly supplied meter, the whole 30-day blocks needed to cover the days still left in the latest strip refill's supply, counted up to a whole block, plus one more 30-day block; otherwise, when the days from the ship date through the valid-through date of the newest authorization grant for test strips are fewer than the tier's supply days per shipment, they are the whole 30-day blocks those days hold; and otherwise they are the tier's supply days per shipment.

- The days still left in the latest strip refill's supply are its supply days less the calendar days since its ship date, never below 0.
- The days from the ship date through the grant's valid-through date count both of those days. The newest grant for test strips is the one with the latest decision date.

| Tier | Supply days per shipment |
|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Self-Pay Program | 30 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program | 30 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | 90 |
| Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | 90 |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | 90 |
| Testing Supplies Medicaid Program | 30 |

**Cases (hypothetical dates)**

| Situation | Supply days |
|---|---|
| meter newly supplied; latest strip refill of 90 days shipped 50 days ago, so 40 days left | 40 days need 2 blocks counted up, plus 1: 90 days |
| meter newly supplied; latest strip refill of 30 days shipped 30 days ago, so 0 days left | 0 blocks plus 1: 30 days |
| no new meter; 90-day tier; grant valid through a date 46 days away, ship date included | 46 days hold 1 whole block: 30 days |
| no new meter; 90-day tier; grant valid through a date 90 days away, ship date included | not fewer than 90: 90 days |
| no new meter; 30-day tier; grant valid through a date 29 days away, ship date included | 29 days hold no whole block: 0 days |
